name: Event Date
author: Ben Shaver (bshaver) and Steve Smock updated by Rick Harris
description: This plugin will give you a countdown to a specified date

privacy.summary: Sends your countdown text to the Matrix Message plugin address you enter (this device by default) and copies a script into FPP's scripts folder. Nothing goes online.

sends.to: http://the Matrix Message plugin address you enter (127.0.0.1 by default)
sends.why: to show the countdown on the matrix straight away

systemChanges.what: copies RUN-COUNTDOWN-SCRIPT.sh into FPP's scripts folder (/home/fpp/media/scripts) at install

privacy.other: The countdown message is written into the Message Queue plugin's database and its own plugin log records the event name, date and message. The copied script and the plugin settings remain after uninstall.
